_rule: External research says what the wider ecosystem does. It never overrides own-account analytics; disagreements are recorded.

findings.claim: Nearly 1 in 3 Gen Z (29%) report frequently feeling lonely; 39% frequently feel anxiety about important decisions.
Gen Z report rising anxiety, loneliness, self-doubt and a desire for authentic connection.
findings.source: Gloo/Barna State of the Church release via RNS (May 2025)

findings.claim: Instagram's head named watch time, sends per reach and likes per reach as the top ranking signals (Jan 2025); sends matter more for non-follower reach. No weights published.
findings.source: Secondary summaries of Adam Mosseri, Jan 2025

findings.claim: Since 31 Mar 2025 any YouTube Shorts play counts as a view; engaged views, viewed-vs-swiped and average % viewed are the quality measures.
World Mental Health Day is 10 Oct 2026, theme 'Lived experiences heard: real voices, real change'.

opportunities.opportunity: Loneliness and decision anxiety as specific human moments (eating alone at a hostel, choosing a course or job).
Sat 10 Oct: a lived-experience episode on mental health, written as one real moment, no clinical framing.
Write lines viewers would send to one specific friend (DM-share moments); measure shares/sends where Buffer exposes them.
Judge YouTube on retention metrics, not raw views, because raw Shorts views were inflated by the 2025 change.
